name: @olai/web
//exports: None. This package has two products and neither is an import: a SCRIPT (`bun packages/web/src/build.ts <dist>`, run by default.nix and by `just build-client`) and the directory it writes. The one thing here that IS imported across a package boundary is src/client/testids.ts, and it is imported by path from packages/tests — a declared export list would suggest a library this is not.
//dependencies: @olai/surface for the wire, @olai/format for everything derived — the client computes nothing about the format on its own. The remark/rehype set renders notes at view time; the babel presets exist only for the Bun build's Solid JSX transform (src/build.ts explains why Bun's own transform cannot be used).
